PAYLINE CHART AND RULES
All pays are left to right on adjacent reels, on selected lines, beginning with the leftmost reel, except scatters. Scatter wins are added to the payline wins. Highest payline and/or scatter wins only paid. Line wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line. Scatter wins are multiplied by the total bet value. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.

RISK GAME

Press RISK GAME button, then select RED or BLACK.

If RED / BLACK choice is correct the gamble amount is doubled (X2)

If RED/BLACK choice is not correct the gamble amount is lost and the game is finished
